title: Junction Box
reference: repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { forward } if tile_is r { turn_left } else { turn_right } }
hints: Walk to each wall. Red floor means turn left; anywhere else, turn right.
Inside a loop: while no wall ahead, forward. Then an if: on red turn left, else turn right.
repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { forward } if tile_is r { turn_left } else { turn_right } }

story.intro: PATCH: "An if block asks once and picks a branch. Tap its sensor to change what it asks."
